head: Biblio Times lays out your news feeds as a morning newspaper
dek: Biblio Times collects the public feeds of the publications you choose each morning and lays them out as a newspaper with a front page, sections and columns. It was #45 among free News apps on the US App Store on 7 November.
details: It's free with in-app purchases, by Groov Creator.
where: iPhone and iPad, App Store, free
means: If you miss reading a paper, it turns your feeds into one.
todo: Find Biblio Times in the App Store.
